stances.summary: CDC should improve policy communication for pandemic preparedness
stances.quote:
On preparing for the next pandemic, @ashishkjha.bsky.social says “politics and policy do go together whether we like it or not.”
He and @jessicamalaty.bsky.social say CDC needs to focus on communicating policy better.  #AspenIdeasHealth #healthpolicy

stances.summary: Opposes sending Americans exposed to Ebola to Kenya as cruel and counterproductive
stances.quote:
I wrote about why the "send Americans exposed to Ebola to Kenya" is such a bad policy

Is it cruel? Sure

But is it also counterproductive? You bet
